written: 2026-11-25, after all five round-2 variants were built, recorded and gate-checked (d7bc188) and re-recorded on the fixed kit; criteria.r2.json was frozen before any variant existed (4807629, 2026-11-24 21:58 MST)
boundary: Recorded before robot_msg_viz joined the directory (83e81b7): the live site now reads 15 packages and 67 types (its 82 import rows add the 36 types only it views), so live numbers differ from these captions. Five single-file React Flow builds on one shared kit (src/kit, 75fd9ca + fixes bf2705a), all reading the real site/data/graph.json (14 packages, 31 types, 256 uses, 2 agents at recording time), health.json (tests on main, declaration lint, types, release vs pin, repo: 4 failing, 10 warnings, 2 passing) and versions.json (Live, Latest release from v* tags = 4 of 14 packages, 11 gh-pages snapshots) at runtime, plus the real pick-and-place run (simulated MuJoCo plant). Recorded from the running builds in headless Chrome at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. Applied to the live site behind the Site design switcher; nothing is the shipped single page yet.
defaultWhy: V6 Repo leads at 96/100: it opens on your V2 type view with 'What can I do with it?' beside it (zero actions for JointTrajectory, 't' for any other type), carries health on every screen (header pill, red tab counter, a PR-style checks box) and puts the version picker where GitHub's branch picker is, so nothing has to be learned. V7 Workbench, V8 Type Search and V10 Docs tie 4 points behind at 92, each for a different reader, so the lead is real but not large.
decisionHinge: Who the site is for first. All five max out types and versions, so the gap comes from health framing, the package views and the first minute. Moving weight around barely moves V6: with health weighted above types (swap FR1 and FR2) it is still 96 to V9's 90; only if the outsider's first minute weighed as much as types (FR6 30, FR1 10) does V10 Docs tie it at 92 as the public front door. The real hinge is taste rather than score: whether a GitHub look-alike reads as familiar or as a site pretending to have issues, stars and PRs it doesn't — if the latter, V8 Type Search (cleanest type-first home) or V10 Docs (cleanest first minute) is the pick at 92.
